summary: Tested multi-marketplace Portals feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 13/15 pytest tests pass. Portals seeded (6), CRUD works, sales/uploads filters by portal, existing sales back-filled with portal='myntra'. Frontend: Masters Portals tab, PortalSwitcher, Uploads portal picker & warning banner all render correctly with proper data-testids. Two critical bugs found: (1) POST /api/portals/reset-defaults returns 422 due to FastAPI route-ordering (caught by /portals/{code}); (2) PortalContext only fetches portals if token exists at PortalProvider mount — after login the switcher shows only 'All Portals' until user hits F5.

critical.issue: Returns 422 'Field required (body)'. Route is shadowed by POST /api/portals/{code} which is declared earlier in routers/portals.py. FastAPI matches path params before literals when the parametrized route is registered first — so 'reset-defaults' is treated as a portal code and the empty body fails PortalUpsert validation. Fix: move @router.post('/portals/reset-defaults') ABOVE @router.post('/portals/{code}') in /app/backend/routers/portals.py (lines 69-84).

minor.issue: Not exposed on public preview URL (returns HTML index). Cannot verify OpenAPI portal param via public URL; source inspection of uploads_r.py confirms portal query param is present.

integration_issues.issue: PortalProvider.useEffect only calls load() if localStorage.getItem('kazo_token') is truthy AT MOUNT TIME. Since PortalProvider wraps <BrowserRouter/> and mounts BEFORE the user logs in, the token is null, load() is skipped, and no re-fetch is triggered after successful login. Result: PortalSwitcher shows only 'All Portals' option and Masters > Portals tab shows an empty list until the user manually refreshes the page (F5). Fix: reload portals whenever the auth token becomes available — e.g. listen to a login event, watch localStorage token, or reload from the login handler / an AuthContext.

action_items: HIGH: In /app/backend/routers/portals.py, move the @router.post('/portals/reset-defaults') handler above @router.post('/portals/{code}') so FastAPI matches the literal path first. Currently returns 422.

HIGH: In /app/frontend/src/context/PortalContext.jsx, portals are only fetched if token exists at mount. Add a mechanism to refetch after login — options: (a) call reload() from the login submit handler, (b) subscribe to a storage/auth event, (c) run the effect whenever the token in localStorage changes. Without this, the PortalSwitcher / Masters Portals tab is empty for the entire session until the user manually refreshes.
LOW: Consider serving /openapi.json publicly (or /docs) for API introspection.
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering pitfall: FastAPI matches routes in registration order — always declare literal paths (e.g. /reset-defaults, /export) BEFORE catch-all path params (/{code}). This class of bug will resurface for any future admin actions on portals; consider grouping them under a distinct sub-prefix like /portals/actions/reset.

PortalContext depends on a global localStorage token check inside a useEffect with only [load] deps — this is racy with the login flow. A first-class AuthContext that exposes the current user/token as React state would remove the need for storage polling and give PortalProvider a proper dependency to re-fetch on.
PortalUpsert accepts arbitrary fee_heads / case_matrix as List[Dict] with no schema validation — an admin PUT can corrupt a portal's rate card silently. Consider stricter Pydantic models.
GET /api/portals runs 2 count_documents() per portal (12 extra queries). For 6 portals it's fine; if this grows, batch via aggregation.

rca_of_the_issues.reset_defaults_422: FastAPI resolves routes in the order they are added to the router. In routers/portals.py, @router.post('/portals/{code}') is declared at L69-76, then @router.post('/portals/reset-defaults') at L79-84. A POST to /api/portals/reset-defaults therefore matches the {code} route first (with code='reset-defaults'), and because the request body is empty, Pydantic's PortalUpsert body validation raises 422 'Field required'. Reproduction: `curl -X POST $URL/api/portals/reset-defaults -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin>"` → 422. Mitigation: move the reset-defaults handler above the {code} handler.
rca_of_the_issues.portal_switcher_empty_until_reload: PortalProvider's useEffect fires once on mount with `if (localStorage.getItem('kazo_token')) load();`. PortalProvider is mounted at App root before login, so token is null and load() is skipped. After login, no dependency changes (deps=[load] which is memoised) so the effect never re-runs. Reproduction: fresh incognito → /login → sign in → wait → open PortalSwitcher → only 'All Portals' shown → F5 → all 7 options appear. Mitigation: expose an authenticated flag from AuthContext (or watch a token state) and re-run load() when it flips true; or call reload() explicitly from the login success handler.
